from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework import permissions, status
from decimal import Decimal
from .models import MultiCurrencyTreasuryAccount

class TreasuryCurrencyConversionView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request):
        account_id = request.data.get("account_id")
        from_curr = request.data.get("from_currency")
        to_curr = request.data.get("to_currency")
        amount = Decimal(str(request.data.get("amount")))

        # Verify account belongs to user and user is an authorized signatory
        account = MultiCurrencyTreasuryAccount.objects.filter(
            id=account_id,
            authorized_signatories=request.user
        ).first()
        if not account:
            return Response({"error": "Account not found or access denied"}, status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND)

        # Fetch trusted exchange rate from audited market rate provider
        market_rate = account.get_audited_market_rate(from_curr, to_curr)
        converted = amount * market_rate
        account.execute_currency_swap(from_curr, to_curr, amount, converted)
        return Response({"status": "Conversion executed", "debited": str(amount), "credited": str(converted)})
